'''Level 1313''' was a level on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|metropolitan]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], so named because it was located one thousand, three hundred, and thirteen levels from the core of Coruscant, which was accessed by the [[Underworld portal/Legends|underworld portal]].<ref name="TCW:TCAJ" />

About a [[1 BBY/Legends|year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], criminals [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Dr. Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] were chased through Level 1313 by [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant police]].<ref name="SWIANH">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|cardname=One Year Earlier - Ponda Baba and Dr. Evazan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Level 1313 was originally announced to be the setting of the third person shooter ''[[Star Wars: 1313]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]].<ref name="Gametrailers look">{{WebCite|url=http://www.gametrailers.com/episode/gametrailers-tv/157|text=E3 First Look Special (June 1, 2012) - Dominic Robilliard interview|archivedate=20120523153549}}</ref> Following the shutdown of [[LucasArts]] in [[2013]], the game was cancelled,<ref name="kotaku">{{WebCite|url=https://kotaku.com/disney-shuts-down-lucasarts-468473749|text=Disney Shuts Down LucasArts, Cancels Star Wars 1313 And Star Wars: First Assault|author=Schreier, Jason|date=2013-04-03|archivedate=20200321154742}}</ref> also revealing it would have starred [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Bounties">{{WebCite|url=https://www.kotaku.com.au/2013/04/before-it-was-cancelled-star-wars-1313-was-going-to-be-about-boba-fett|text=Before It Was Cancelled, ''Star Wars 1313'' Was Going To Be About Boba Fett|author=Schreier, Jason|date=2013-04-04|archivedate=20200108204432}}</ref> The level first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|The Clone Wars]]' ''[[:The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode, "[[Lethal Trackdown]]" and [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episode, "[[To Catch a Jedi]]."

{{CutStart}}
At some point during the existence of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Level 1313 was the site of a ruthless criminal underground network<ref name="LucasArts">{{LucasArts|url=company/release/news20120531.html|text=LucasArts Drops Gamers into the Criminal Underworld with New Mature Themed Videogame Franchise, Star Wars 1313™}}</ref> which was investigated by Boba Fett.<ref name="Bounties" />
{{CutEnd}}
